biggest_catch: LTK publishes no concrete public creator commission rate — commissions are brand-set CPA rates that LTK's own brand toolkit leaves as blank '[INSERT CPA %]' placeholders, so there is no concrete figure to verify.
catches: Official LTK Business Terms of Service confirm creators earn commissions on sales via affiliate networks, but the rate is the brand's CPA — set by the brand, non-negotiable, and varying by retailer.
LTK's own brand toolkit template reads 'Earn up to [INSERT CPA %] commission' — the rate is literally a blank filled in per brand.
No concrete public commission figure or platform-set rate is published in LTK's official terms.
Rejected on the same bar as Insense, Trend, AspireIQ, Creator.co, and Tribe: no concrete official creator rate.

c1.evidence: LTK (rewardStyle Inc) is a real company; official terms on LTK's legal/brand domains (company.shopltk.com, onbrand.shopltk.com).

c2.evidence: No concrete creator pay figure or platform-set commission rate in official terms — rates are per-brand CPA, non-negotiable, with blank template placeholders.

c3.evidence: No participation fee established from official terms.

c4.evidence: No official payout quote exists — nothing concrete to quote.

eligibility: Creators apply via the LTK Creator app; commission rates are set per brand/retailer and are non-negotiable.
notes: Reviewed 2026-09-22: LTK's official Business Terms of Service (via its PactSafe legal publication) and brand toolkit confirm the commission mechanic but never a concrete public rate — the brand toolkit literally templates the rate as '[INSERT CPA %]'. Weekly payouts for creators are officially announced, but payout timing without a concrete rate does not clear the user's bar.
